title: Remove Settings audio subtitle builder flat exports
summary: Removed ten transitional flat Settings audio/subtitle builder aliases while preserving the helpers on mediaPipelineSettingsView.
reason: WebView flat export cleanup remains an active opportunistic workstream. The audio and subtitle Settings builder helpers are still namespace-exported and passed internally through Settings dependency injection, so their direct window.* aliases can be retired without changing backend-owned settings mutation boundaries.
behavior_before: settingsView.js exposed audio and subtitle builder sync, collect, apply, guidance, and dirty-marker helpers both through mediaPipelineSettingsView and as direct window.* compatibility aliases.
behavior_after: The audio and subtitle builder helpers remain available through mediaPipelineSettingsView and existing Settings module dependency injection, but no longer create direct window.* aliases. The global export inventory and WebView public contract baseline now report 450 flat exports.
tests_added: tests.webview.test_webview_handbrake_settings_ui.WebViewHandBrakeSettingsUiTests.test_settings_audio_subtitle_builder_helpers_are_namespace_only_exports asserts the audio/subtitle builder helpers remain present while direct flat aliases are absent.
manual_validation: Baseline targeted test failed before source edit because window.syncSubtitleSettingsBuilderFromConfig still existed.

rg "window\.(syncSubtitleSettingsBuilderFromConfig|collectSubtitleSettingsBuilderPatch|applySubtitleSettingsBuilderToPatch|renderSubtitleSettingsBuilderGuidance|markSubtitleSettingsBuilderDirty|syncAudioSettingsBuilderFromConfig|collectAudioSettingsBuilderPatch|applyAudioSettingsBuilderToPatch|renderAudioSettingsBuilderGuidance|markAudioSettingsBuilderDirty)" apps\desktop\webview\static tests\webview Docs\inventories -n returned no matches after removal.
rollback_plan: Revert this packet to restore the ten Settings direct window.* audio/subtitle builder aliases, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline, godfile map, split candidates, global export inventory, summaries, and restore the flat export count from 450 to 460.
notes: Remove ten Settings audio/subtitle builder direct window aliases while keeping namespace exports.
